text:
Maya: Quick q — we need to pick a default persist location for 'Quick Save' in route/model analytics. Product prefers route-scoped; Platform wants org-scoped defaults so infra can apply quotas.
Kevin: Route-scoped by default. Users expect a saved view to stick to a route.
Sophie: UX-wise I agree, but duplication across routes/orgs will blow up quotas. Could we store an "origin" and mark copies so billing shows dedup hints?
Raj: API-side preference is a single POST /savedviews with optional scope="route"|"model"|"org"|"team". Origin metadata is fine.
Alyssa: ACL question — who can edit a route-scoped saved view? Creator-only or route-admin override? Product leans creator-only; Platform wants admins to correct broken views.
Maya: Proposal: let route-admins override but require an explicit "override" flag that creates an audit entry and emits telemetry. Also allow creator to set "locked":true to prevent casual overrides; overrides still possible but must be auditable.
Kevin: Note: adding "locked" needs a migration and a check in the update path. Also we need telemetry for override attempts.
Sophie: From console: when saving show three checkboxes: Share with team, Make org-default, Lock from edits. If user changes scope from route->org show "copy vs move" modal.
Raj: API draft:
```
POST /savedviews
{
  "name": "High-latency filters",
  "scope": "route",
  "route_id": "r_123",
  "filters": {"latency_ms_gt": 200},
  "share": "team",
  "locked": false
}
```
Response 201: { id, effective_scope, origin_user }
Alyssa: For quotas/billing Platform wants to count saved views by configurable key (route, org, billing_key). Suggest adding billing_key to savedview metadata.
Maya: Telemetry: emit savedview.create, savedview.update, savedview.override with props {scope, route_id, locked, from_scope_change, quota_hit:false}. Also emit savedview.lock_attempt when admin tries to override a locked view.
Kevin: Rollout: feature-flag backend + migration first. Then console UX behind flag. Soft-default org-scope off for everyone for 2 weeks, then enable for new orgs + opt-in for existing.
Sophie: Copy detail: copying a view to a new scope should create a new id and set forked_from referencing original id. Keep created_at/created_by.
Raj: I'll sketch the API PR and schema changes (saved_views table: id,name,scope,route_id,filters,json,locked,bool,forked_from,origin_user,billing_key). Agree on lock semantics + events?
Maya: Agree on lock semantics. Add UI hint about quota impact when toggling org-scope.
Alyssa: I'll add billing note so customers don't accidentally explode costs by setting many org-default views.
deploy-bot: Migration savedviews_add_scope_lock_billing_key applied by Raj at 2024-07-22T16:12:05Z :rocket:
Maya: Thanks — can we get API PR up today so we can start UX mockups tomorrow?
Kevin: I'll review once Raj opens the PR.
Sophie: I'll draft modal copy for copy vs move and quota hint.
Raj: PR coming in ~2h. I'll include migration and telemetry events.
Maya: SG — tagging @eng-platform to keep an eye on quota implications.
